facts.rule: Selected real File ranges preserve the tested positions across2^31/2^32;13 independently checked reads include a1MiB request,zero ranges,and EOF short/clamped results.
facts.constraint: Validate exact offset/length/returned bytes before publication. Raw Blob.slice clamping is not a valid complete requested range.
facts.acceptance_limit: Observed4GiB+8192B sparse original fixture;not an arbitrary ZIP64 domain or full-resource/memory-capacity acceptance.

facts.rule: After the controlled same-size source mutation,the held File size/lastModified remain unchanged while the next slice read returns NotReadableError.
facts.constraint: File metadata is not an independent content revalidation. An unreadable/changed binding must stop admitting reads,settle inflight work and require validated rebind rather than reuse stale source metadata.
facts.acceptance_limit: One local Chrome source-change path;other host source/permission errors need their own receipt.

facts.rule: An active.put request succeeds before transaction complete;explicit abort at that point retains active A/revision1 and leaves no abort-only receipt.
facts.constraint: Only backend transaction complete may authorize committed success. Abort and pending request errors settle without publishing request-success as a commit.
facts.acceptance_limit: Actual browser transaction primitive,not the full SnapshotStore cancel matrix or power-loss durability.

facts.rule: Two distinct page DB connections compare expected revision1 and publish in overlapping readwrite scopes;one commits revision2 and the other observes revision2/conflict.
facts.constraint: Expected-revision comparison and pointer/receipt writes share the same authoritative transaction. A per-page mutex alone does not cover the measured two-connection case.
facts.acceptance_limit: One origin and owned Chrome profile;not WeChat journal,distributed writers,or a guarantee from an unrelated mutex.

facts.rule: Views share16B backing;copy remains independent;transfer detaches original/view. IndexedDB put/get use independent values:caller9,held old read1,later stored read7.
facts.constraint: Account backing allocations,copies and backend serialization separately. A retained JS read value is not an implemented snapshot pin/lease.
facts.acceptance_limit: Raw allocation semantics only;peak RSS,complete-manifest budget,concurrent decode/audio/cache and cancellation charges remain unmeasured.

facts.rule: After an actual normal Chrome close/relaunch on the owned profile and same origin,boot/timeOrigin differ and committed revision2/receipt recover;incomplete staging remains inactive.
facts.constraint: Recovery must inspect authoritative commit identity after a new boot;an incomplete candidate is not automatically active.
facts.acceptance_limit: Clean restart of this probe only;no abrupt kill,power loss,game updater takeover or complete restart-intent implementation tested.

facts.rule: CDP compositionstart is trusted in the trace,but both recorded compositionend events are untrusted. After focus moves to B,the later insertText enters B;A keeps its prior composition text.
facts.constraint: Track source owner/focus/epoch explicitly. CDP event acceptance and isTrusted alone do not prove actual OS IME lifecycle or source-owner admission.
facts.acceptance_limit: Actual Chrome renderer events driven by CDP;physical macOS/mobile IME and the product epoch guard are not accepted.

facts.rule: Desktop mouse and390x844 CDP touch/cancel map to source point160,240;touch pointerdown and pointercancel are trusted.
facts.constraint: Use current viewport inverse transform and cancel the matching pointer owner. Keep viewport emulation separate from device touch acceptance.
facts.acceptance_limit: One desktop and one mobile-shaped viewport in the same desktop Chrome;not a physical phone or WeChat.

facts.rule: 50 frame samples are nondecreasing over830.8ms monotonic/831ms wall time;maximum observed gap18.3ms. The accepted350ms CDP frozen interval did not produce an observed frame pause.
facts.constraint: Command success is not an observed background transition. Source u32 origin,absolute deadlines,rebase/catchup and true hidden/resume behavior remain separate required parameters.
facts.acceptance_limit: This visible headless window only;no fixed60Hz policy,source time equivalence or real background conformance inferred.

facts.rule: IndexedDB reports strict durability for the test transactions;storage.persisted is false. The returned quota is only an estimate and differs with current usage.
facts.constraint: Do not turn quota/deviceMemory hints or strict durability into verified capacity,eviction immunity or power-loss guarantees.
facts.acceptance_limit: No quota exhaustion/persistence permission/full manifest/device memory tests were performed.

mobile_safari_stream_lifecycle.classification: iOS 模拟器中的实际 Safari WebSocket、现有浏览器适配器和本机 TCP 桥
observed: 登录流写入收到序号 0 的 written，TCP 实收相同 5 字节。
同一 Safari 文档隐藏 4914 毫秒，游戏流读取 6 字节并在恢复命令前报告。登录流在所选 9000 毫秒期限到期，TCP 关闭后，浏览器收 BRIDGE_TIMEOUT 与 STREAM_READ。
并行读返回 STREAM_BUSY，取消待处理游戏读返回 STREAM_ABORTED，旧 TCP 实际关闭。替换连接独立发送 3 字节，读完 7 字节和 EOF。
mobile_safari_stream_lifecycle.design_rule: 传输接收可发生在绘制间隔内。按连接身份核对本机写入回执、读取消、物理退役和独立重连。
